gaps.term: Map out of Q determined by image of w
gaps.quote: A map out of $Q$ is determined by the image of $w$
gaps.note: This holds only if the map fixes complex scalars. The page requires only phi(1)=1 and never says that complex scalars are preserved, so the reader cannot check the claim.
Only one product, (1+w) squared, is checked. The page does not give the general argument, so the reader cannot check that the map preserves all products.

gaps.term: Basis claim for the bijectivity of phi
gaps.quote: sends the basis $1,w$ of $Q$ to the basis $1,\sqrt{-1}\,y$ of $Q'$
gaps.note: The page never shows that 1 and sqrt(-1) y form a basis of Q' (that each element of Q' has a unique form), nor that 1 and w form a basis of Q, so the reader cannot check the bijectivity conclusion.

gaps.quote: This is a ring homomorphism, because $\psi(w)=1$ satisfies $w^2=1$.
gaps.note: The page gives only the well-definedness condition, and only as a necessary condition. It checks no products for psi, so the reader cannot verify that psi preserves both operations.
